hero.paragraph: From single-parcel urgent dispatches to high-volume API-driven routing. Explore the physical and digital services we deploy to scale your business.

services.title: B2B Bulk Manifests
services.shortDesc: High-volume, automated routing for enterprise merchants.
services.description: Stop manually entering orders. Upload your daily dispatch manifest via CSV or API, and our system automatically routes, batches, and assigns the deliveries to our urban fleet. Designed for e-commerce platforms, distributors, and corporate partners who need to move hundreds of parcels a day without friction.

services.title: On-Demand Courier
services.description: When it has to be there right now. Request a rider instantly through our web platform or WhatsApp. We guarantee rapid pickup and direct door-to-door delivery with zero warehouse layovers. Perfect for urgent documents, retail single-orders, and emergency parts logistics.

services.title: COD Management
services.shortDesc: Secure, audited cash collection and remittance.
services.description: Cash on Delivery is the lifeblood of local commerce, but chasing payments slows you down. We secure your funds at the exact moment of drop-off. Our riders digitally log the collection, and our treasury department remits the full amount directly to your verified bank or mobile money account within 48 hours.

services.title: Regional Logistics
services.shortDesc: Linehaul transport beyond the city limits.
services.description: Expand your market reach without building your own fleet. We execute structured transport runs to major provincial hubs upcountry and coordinate highly secure cross-border logistics into neighboring markets like the DRC and Uganda.

cta.heading: Not sure which tier fits?
cta.paragraph: Let our operations team audit your current shipping volume and build a custom pricing model that scales with you.
